name: Giant Bloodseeker AP OLD
source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm

generalAbilities.name: Blood-Crazed
generalAbilities.description: If the bloodseeker starts its turn within 60 feet of a creature with bleed damage, it must attempt a DC 11 Flat . On a failure, the bloodseeker attempts to move adjacent to the bleeding creature and Strike it with its proboscis. The bloodseeker gains a +4 circumstance bonus to attack rolls against this target.

offensiveAbilities.name: Blood Drain
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The bloodseeker's last action was a successful Strike with its proboscis against a target with blood

Effect The bloodseeker sucks blood from that target, dealing 2d4 damage, and the bloodseeker gains temporary Hit Points equal to the damage dealt. The target becomes Drained 1.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
